claims.text: Nematus implements an attentional encoder–decoder architecture similar to the one described by Bahdanau et al.
The architecture includes concatenation of forward and backward encoder RNN hidden states for source annotations.
Nematus has been empirically shown to perform strongly, indicating its architecture is effective for Neural Machine Translation.
